name: tatzeroko-apex-multiproject-experimental

commands.title: Tatzeroko (experimental): Restart Apex server for a project

tatzeroko.experimental.apexMultiProject..description: Run one Apex language server per nested Salesforce DX project. Experimental; off by default.
nested: serve only nested projects (the root project stays with the Salesforce extension). all: serve every project including the root (duplicate providers if Salesforce Apex is active).
Publish diagnostics from the experimental servers. Off by default (noisy on real projects).

Absolute path of the extracted pinned TypeScript Apex server's `extension` directory (must contain dist/server.node.js). Run `npm run prepare:server` in the PoC package to download, SHA-256 verify and print it. Never bundled.
Jorje engine only. Path to an apex-jorje-lsp.jar. Empty = auto-detect the JAR inside the installed official Salesforce Apex extension (read in place, never copied).
Jorje engine only. Path to the java executable. Empty = use salesforcedx-vscode-apex java.home, then JAVA_HOME, then `java` on PATH.

description: Experimental, opt-in: one Apex language server per nested Salesforce DX project. Companion to the official Salesforce extensions. Not published.
